Class RmiServer

java.lang.Object
java.rmi.server.RemoteObject
java.rmi.server.RemoteServer
java.rmi.server.UnicastRemoteObject
it.polimi.ingsw.am48.network.server.RmiServer
All Implemented Interfaces:
VirtualServer, VirtualServerRmi, Serializable, Remote
public class RmiServer extends UnicastRemoteObject implements VirtualServerRmi
Server-side RMI endpoint, exported as the remote object "MesosServer" and looked up by every RmiClient.

This class implements VirtualServerRmi: each method receives a remote call from a client, delegates the actual game logic to GameController, and forwards the resulting deltas or snapshots to the relevant clients via MesosServer's broadcast methods. Game-rule exceptions are caught and reported back only to the originating client through its registered VirtualViewRmi callback.

rmiCallbacks maps each connected player's nickname to their remote callback object, registered via connect(String, VirtualViewRmi). This map is used to look up where to send reportError and showInitialSnapshot replies that must go only to the calling client (as opposed to deltas, which are broadcast to the whole game via MesosServer).

  • Method Details

    • connect

      public void connect(String nickname, VirtualViewRmi client) throws RemoteException
      Registers the calling client's RMI callback object with the server, so that subsequent game notifications (deltas, snapshots, errors) can be pushed to it.

      Must be called once, before any other command, immediately after the client has been exported as a remote object.

      Registers the client's remote callback under its nickname in rmiCallbacks, then wraps it in a RmiViewAdapter — which starts its own heartbeat against this client — and registers that adapter as the client's VirtualView with MesosServer.

      The onDisconnect callback passed to the adapter is invoked by the adapter's heartbeat when this client stops responding. When triggered, it removes the client from rmiCallbacks, terminates the client's game via GameController.handleClientDisconnect(String), notifies the remaining players ("companions") that the game has ended, and unregisters the client from MesosServer.

      Specified by:
      connect in interface VirtualServerRmi
      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname the client intends to use for this session
      client - the client's own remote callback object, used by the server to invoke VirtualViewRmi methods on this client
      Throws:
      RemoteException - if the RMI call fails

    • joinGame

      public void joinGame(int numPlayers, String nickname) throws RemoteException
      Sends a request to join or create a game with the given number of players.

      Delegates to GameController.handleJoinGame(int, String). If the join completes the lobby, the initial snapshot is broadcast to every player in the game via MesosServer.broadcastSnapshotToGame(List, GameSnapshot); otherwise it is sent only to this client through its rmiCallbacks entry. Any exception is reported back to the calling client only.

      Specified by:

      Specified by:

    • takeCard

      public void takeCard(String nickname, String cardId) throws RemoteException
      Sends a request to take a card from the showed rows.

      Delegates to GameController.handleTakeCard(String, String) and broadcasts every resulting GameDelta to all players in the game via MesosServer.broadcastToGame(List, GameDelta). If this move ends the game, the delta list transparently includes a trailing LeaderboardDelta, which is broadcast like any other delta. Any exception is reported back to the calling client only.

    • ping

      public void ping() throws RemoteException
      No-op method used as a liveness probe.

      If the server is reachable, this call returns normally; if the server process has crashed or is unreachable, RMI raises a RemoteException, which the caller's heartbeat thread interprets as a server crash.

      No-op: the mere fact that this remote call succeeds tells a client's heartbeat thread that the server is still alive.

      Specified by:
      ping in interface VirtualServerRmi
      Throws:
      RemoteException - if the server is unreachable
